mapper.select: SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND action='role.manage' AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT role_id,current_version,revision FROM enterprise_role_head h WHERE role_id=#{roleId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT version_id,name,approval_basis,approval_basis_sha256,approval_reason,authority_grant,authority_revision,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM enterprise_role_publication p WHERE version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE enterprise_role_head SET current_version=#{versionId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE role_id=#{roleId} AND revision=#{headRevision}
UPDATE enterprise_role_version SET status='REVOKED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE version_id=#{versionId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT invitation_id,user_id,identity_id,roles,scope,authorization_manifest,basis_version,credential_sha256, expires_at,status,created_by,created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM member_invitation i WHERE status='PENDING' AND JSON_CONTAINS(roles,JSON_OBJECT('version_id',#{versionId})) ORDER BY invitation_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.grant_id,g.subject_id,g.project_id,g.resource_kind,g.resource_id,g.action,g.`condition`,g.status,g.valid_from,g.valid_to, g.basis_version,g.schema_version,g.schema_manifest_sha256,g.revision FROM permission_grant g INNER JOIN member_role_grant r ON r.grant_id=g.grant_id WHERE r.role_version=#{versionId} AND g.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.grant_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_invitation SET status=CASE WHEN expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'REVOKED' END, terminal_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),terminal_reason=#{reason},revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE invitation_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE tenant SET auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE auth_epoch=#{auth} AND governance_epoch=#{governance}
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
